Chapter 1180 - 4: Developing Chaos Continent (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1180: Chapter 4: Developing Chaos Continent (Seeking Subscription)

Compared to the previous dozens of source objects, the Void Golden Leaf has the greatest impact on the universe within Lin Yuan’s body.

Just upon preliminary fusion and absorption, Lin Yuan felt his internal universe beginning to transform and evolve.

Buzz!

At the center of the universe.

The power of the Void Golden Leaf formed a half-meter tall small tree.

The small tree appeared extremely fragile, and compared to the towering, massive Chaos Tree beside it, it was exceptionally inconspicuous.

But it was precisely this small tree that made the Chaos Tree tremble with fear, and the scattered Chaos Qi did not dare to come near it.

"Void Divine Tree?"

Lin Yuan looked at the small tree, which bore a six to seventy percent resemblance to the Void Divine Tree in the mysterious realm.

The biggest difference was their size; the actual Void Divine Tree had a single leaf as vast as an entire Void Domain.

...

More than a dozen source objects integrated into the internal universe.

Lin Yuan closed his eyes to feel the changes before and after.

"Three hundred trillion light-years in scale."

Lin Yuan looked at the size of his internal universe, which was the most straightforward change.

In addition, the depth and thickness of the internal universe’s foundation had also improved significantly.

This enhancement was foundational and could evolve alongside the future transformations of Lin Yuan’s internal universe.

"With my current strength, even if I still can’t defeat the Great Saint Hunxiao, I can now safely retreat from an encirclement by two Extraordinary Great Saints," Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Inside the Xuanhuang Universe, facing two Extraordinary Great Saints, Lin Yuan felt immense pressure; even with full effort, he couldn’t escape even by detonating the external universe.

But now?

With the breakthrough into the Ninth Realm of Space-Time and the transformation of the internal universe, Lin Yuan was not far from matching a true Extraordinary Great Saint.

The internal universe gave Lin Yuan such a tremendous advantage that he was able to significantly close the gap, despite being otherwise equal or even inferior to an Extraordinary Great Saint.

"With my current foundation, once I break into the Chaos Realm, I might directly reach the level of an Invincible Great Saint?"

Lin Yuan mused, realizing that before fusing with the numerous source objects, his estimate was that after breaking into the Chaos Realm, his combat power might approach that of an Invincible Great Saint.

However, the dozen-plus source objects indeed significantly elevated Lin Yuan’s own foundation.

With the current baseline strength, once Lin Yuan steps into the Chaos Realm and experiences another metamorphic leap, possessing the power of an Invincible Great Saint is not an unlikely outcome.

"Take it slow."

"The Chaos Realm shouldn’t be far off."

Lin Yuan thought, realizing that stepping into the Chaos Realm posed no difficulty for him; he just needed to wait until his physical body and Soul Body universe matured to their limits.

Lin Yuan had already met most of the prerequisites for crossing the threshold into the Chaos Realm during the Path Splitting Realm.

...

Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.

Lin Yuan’s figure flashed, appearing in the Void where Chaos Qi drifted.

"Great Saint, where do you plan to establish the Chaos Continent?" the Ancient Ming Venerable also arrived, probing and asking.

"Here, I suppose."

Lin Yuan glanced around and said.

This location had no other Chaos Continents nearby, making it suitable for establishing his own Chaos Continent.

"Alright."

The Ancient Ming Venerable nodded and then cautiously asked, "During the establishment of the Chaos Continent, will you allow other Venerables to observe?"

The establishment of a Chaos Continent requires considerable time and will attract a lot of Chaos Qi gathering and Space-Time fluctuations, inevitably drawing the attention of nearby Venerables.

Especially given Lin Yuan’s insights into Space-Time, the establishment of his Chaos Continent would surely cause commotion far exceeding that of a normal Chaos Venerable.

"They’re welcome to."

Lin Yuan said.

He didn’t mind other Chaos Venerables observing the establishment of his Chaos Continent.

As long as they didn’t interfere with him.

"Good."

The Ancient Ming Venerable nodded.

The establishment of a Chaos Continent entails many deep principles of Space-Time.

For many newly advanced Venerables, observing a Chaos Venerable establish a Chaos Continent offers considerable benefit.

Even for some seasoned Venerables, watching other Venerables set up a Chaos Continent offers some insights.

This is generally true for normal Chaos Venerables, let alone for a Chaos Great Saint like Lin Yuan.

The Ancient Ming Venerable didn’t even have to think about it; there would definitely be a horde of Venerables and even Great Saints coming to watch.

...

Whoosh!

Lin Yuan stepped forward, standing amidst endless Chaos Qi.

"Space-Time..."

Lin Yuan gazed into the vast Chaos Void, feeling a vague impulse rising within him.

"Establishing a Chaos Continent is a summary of one’s insights into rules, and the created Chaos Continent can also serve as a base."

Lin Yuan contemplated.

Aside from newly advanced Venerables, nearly all Venerables establish a Chaos Continent, because the Space-Time Rule within it will be influenced by the Venerable themselves.

For instance, the Ancient Ming Venerable is much stronger on their own Chaos Continent compared to other Venerables of the same level, capable of instantly tapping into the entire continent’s Space-Time.

The Chaos Continent of the Ancient Ming Venerable is dozens of times the size of an average natural universe, such a vast Space-Time... even peak Venerables would hesitate to venture into it to battle the Ancient Ming Venerable.

"Let’s begin."

Lin Yuan set about the creation.

Rumble.

Massive space-time fluctuations began sweeping in all directions.

Developing the Chaos Continent requires a vast amount of resources, but given Lin Yuan’s current assets, these were naturally no concern.

...

As Lin Yuan continued to develop the Chaos Continent, the space-time fluctuations surged and spread like tides.

In no time, dozens of nearby Void Domains, hundreds of Void Domains, thousands of Void Domains were all alerted by the Chaos Venerables.

"This wave of space-time fluctuation..."

"Is someone developing a Chaos Continent?"

"Why are the space-time fluctuations from building a Chaos Continent so immense?"

A wave of shock passed through the hearts of each venerable. Even as Chaos Venerables themselves, they felt as insignificant as ants before these vast space-time fluctuations.

"A Great Saint, it must be at least a Chaos Great Saint who is developing the Chaos Continent."

Some Chaos Venerables quickly realized that mobilizing such immense space-time power, even a peak Venerable could not achieve.

It must be a Chaos Great Saint, and only a formidable Great Saint among the Chaos Great Saints could accomplish this.

"I have seen a formidable Great Saint developing a Chaos Continent before, and it never gave me such a feeling..."

One venerable was somewhat puzzled.

But no matter their thoughts, upon realizing this new development of the Chaos Continent, nearly all the venerables set out towards the source of the space-time fluctuations.

What a joke, to observe the creation of a Chaos Continent drawn by such power of space-time, these ordinary venerables would be a rare opportunity for great fortune if they could watch closely.

When else would be better to approach?

...

"The Great Saint’s mastery over space-time must have reached the Ninth Realm, right?"

Being the first to closely observe, the Ancient Ming Venerable felt the space-time fluctuations stirred by Lin Yuan’s development of the Chaos Continent most profoundly.

"Ninth Realm of space-time?"

The heart of the Ancient Ming Venerable trembled; this was a domain only supreme Great Saints could touch.

Only by reaching significant heights and depths in their own chaotic evolutionary power path could one further enhance their understanding of space-time, reaching the Ninth Realm of space-time.

As for a Chaos Great Saint attaining the Ninth Realm of space-time comprehension? It’s not impossible, but it’s extremely rare.

At least, the Ancient Ming Venerable had not heard of any Chaos Great Saint whose space-time comprehension had reached the Ninth Realm.

"Hmm?"

The Ancient Ming Venerable suddenly noticed, detecting several Chaos Venerables cautiously approaching.

"Hmph."

The Ancient Ming Venerable paid no mind to them.

Lin Yuan was not opposed to allowing other venerables to observe during the creation of the Chaos Continent, and naturally, the Ancient Ming Venerable wouldn’t interfere either.

"The Great Saint is too benevolent."

The Ancient Ming Venerable marveled inwardly. Not minding others observing was virtually like giving away opportunities for fortune.

...

"We’re here, this is where the Chaos Continent is being developed."

"My heavens, the space-time fluctuations are this vast?"

"Ninth Realm of space-time, it’s a Great Saint whose comprehension of space-time has reached the Ninth Realm developing the Chaos Continent."

The Chaos Venerables who had rushed over were shocked; they had thought it was just an ordinary Chaos Great Saint developing the continent, but were surprised to find that this Great Saint’s understanding of space-time had reached the Ninth Realm.

"Could it be a supreme Great Saint developing the Chaos Continent?"

One venerable swallowed hard, finding it extremely rare.

For one, the number of supreme Great Saints is too few; for another, with the power of a supreme Great Saint, even if they wanted to develop something, they would develop a Postnatal Universe, not a Chaos Continent.

Unless there was some special purpose, a supreme Great Saint wouldn’t specifically develop a Chaos Continent.

"It’s the Galactic Sage, the Galactic Sage is developing the Chaos Continent!"

Some Chaos Venerables used special means to see from afar the majestic figure creating the Chaos Continent amidst the center of space-time fluctuations.

"Galactic Sage?"

"The Galactic Sage outside the Postnatal Universe?"

"No wonder this Galactic Sage could easily suppress eight Chaos Great Saints, possessing a Ninth Realm understanding of space-time..."

A chorus of sighs from the Chaos Venerables, though the Galactic Sage is not a supreme Great Saint, for Chaos Great Saints, he might as well be; even a formidable Great Saint could easily be suppressed by him.

The main battle bodies of Black Light Great Saint, Wild Barbarian Great Saint, and other Chaos Great Saints are still in the hands of the Galactic Sage.

These Chaos Great Saints are currently borrowing Chaos Stones here and there, trying to redeem back their main battle bodies.

"The Galactic Sage is too strong, even watching from afar, the oppressive feeling it gives me..."

The voice of one Chaos Venerable trembled slightly.

When they watched images of the Galactic Sage engaging in combat beyond the Xuanhuang Universe, they didn’t quite feel it, perhaps even offering a few pointers.

But when facing the Galactic Sage for real, even watching from afar, they felt the pressure as if the void itself might collapse.

...

Lin Yuan took several years to preliminarily develop the Chaos Continent, during which his understanding of space-time continually improved.

Creating the Chaos Continent was a unique application of rules like space-time, a process more aligned with creation than slaughter, giving Lin Yuan profound insights.

"It’s just about done."

Lin Yuan was quite satisfied internally.

He looked at the Chaos Continent he had created, and a smile spread across his face.
